mil5.3.9:2.2: taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇaṃ āhu loke ti.
mil5.3.9:3.1: Tatr' ime cattāro dhammā: khanti appāhāratā rativippahānaṃ ākiñcaññaṃ.
mil5.3.9:3.2: Sabbāni pan' etāni aparikkhīṇāsavassa sakilesass' eva honti.
mil5.3.9:3.3: Yadi bhante Nāgasena āsavānaṃ khayā samaṇo hoti, tena hi: Catubbhi dhammehi samangibhūtaṃ taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇaṃ āhu loke ti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.3.9:3.4: Yadi ‘catubbhi dhammehi samangibhūto' samaṇo hoti, tena hi: Āsavānaṃ khayā samaṇo hotīti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā. Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.3.9:4.1: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā: Āsavānaṃ khayā samaṇo hotīti.
mil5.3.9:4.3: Catubbhi dhammehi samangibhūtaṃ taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇaṃ āhu loke ti.
mil5.3.9:4.4: Tad-idaṃ mahārāja vacanaṃ tesaṃ tesaṃ puggalānaṃ guṇavasena bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.3.9:4.5: Catubbhi dhammehi samangibhūtaṃ taṃ ve naraṃ samaṇaṃ āhu loke ti. Idaṃ pana niravasesavacanaṃ: Āsavānaṃ khayā samaṇo hotīti.
mil5.3.9:5.1: Api ca mahārāja ye keci kilesūpasamāya paṭipannā te sabbe upādāy' upādāya samaṇo khīṇāsavo aggam-akkhāyati.
mil5.3.9:5.2: Yathā mahārāja yāni kānici jalajathalajapupphāni vassikaṃ tesaṃ aggam-akkhāyati, avasesāni yāni kānici vividhāni pupphajātāni sabbāni tāni pupphāni yeva, upādāy' upādāya pana vassikaṃ yeva pupphaṃ janassa patthitaṃ pihayitaṃ,
mil5.3.9:5.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja ye keci kilesūpasamāya paṭipannā te sabbe upādāy' upādāya samaṇo khīṇāsavo aggam-akkhāyati.
mil5.3.9:6.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja sabbadhaññānaṃ sāli aggam-akkhāyati, yā kāci avasesā vividhā dhaññajātiyo tā sabbā upādāy' upādāya bhojanāni sarīrayāpanāya, sāli yeva tesaṃ aggam-akkhāyati,
mil5.3.9:6.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja ye keci kilesūpasamāya paṭipannā te sabbe upādāy' upādāya samaṇo khīṇāsavo aggam-akkhāyatīti.-
mil5.3.9:6.3: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
